interactions.note: The epitope of anti-VSD2-NavAb Fab on the voltage-gated sodium channel chimeric protein Nav1.7 VSD2-NavAb was determined from the cryo-EM 3D reconstruction of the complex to a resolution of 3.6 Å.  In the chimeric protein, voltage-sensor domain II (VSD2) from human Nav1.7 replaced the VSD of the homotetrameric bacterial NavAb channel. Antagonist protoxin-II (ProTx2) was complexed with the VSD2 from human voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.7 in an activated state. The Fab fragment targets the central pore module (PM) of the NavAb channel and was added to increase the molecular weight of the complex and assist in particle alignment.

The epitope of anti-VSD2-NavAb Fab on the voltage-gated sodium channel chimeric protein Nav1.7 VSD2-NavAb was determined from the cryo-EM 3D reconstruction of the complex to a resolution of 4.2 Å.  In the chimeric protein, voltage-sensor domain II (VSD2) from human Nav1.7 replaced the VSD of the homotetrameric bacterial NavAb channel. Antagonist protoxin-II (ProTx2) was complexed with the VSD2 from human voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.7 in a deactivated state. The Fab fragment targets the central pore module (PM) of the NavAb channel and was added to increase the molecular weight of the complex and assist in particle alignment.
